author: <PLACEHOLDER: writer session>

main.applies_while: at every run (the pre-landing safeguard, F, landing) main is resolved by git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main and the record applies only if R13 and R1-R12 all hold there (R13, the ledger binding, first): in particular AGENTS.md at that main equals paths[0].blobs.M and the first-parent commits on H..main that change AGENTS.md equal side_change_commits. The record names no later main commit, so the tool's own landing and the plan amendment do not change it; a different AGENTS.md blob means a new record with supersedes

ledger.note: the ledger as frozen at P, from which ledger_binding was computed; the ledger used at a run is the configuration's, bound by R13

ledger_binding.canonical_json: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8, then sha256

agents_splices.selection: ledger splices whose file is AGENTS.md, in ledger order

agents_edit_records.selection: edits.json records whose file is AGENTS.md, in file order

ledger_binding.rule: R13, checked before R1-R12: the ledger and edit list that the configuration uses at the run (adapters.ledger and its companion, read from the object store) must have base = scientific_base and the three canonical hashes above; otherwise the record does not apply (fail closed: base-drift stands) and a superseding record is needed. Equality of the whole ledger and edit-list blobs with ledger.blob_sha256 and edits.blob_sha256 is reported but not required, so an amendment that changes only other files' entries does not void the record. R6, R8 and R10 read the run's ledger and edit list, not the P copies named above

paths.resolution: L:AGENTS.md = main's AGENTS.md with C's splices applied at main-translated offsets, each old_sha256 re-verified against main (DESIGN-v5.1 sec. 13.1; v2 sec. 13.2 'both changed')

unchanged_ledgered.rule: blob at main equals blob at H, and sha256 equals base_sha256, for every other ledger files entry

unchanged_corpus.rule: git diff --name-status H main lists no papers/ or book/ path and no generated corpus artifact (evaluated at run time; not a recorded list)

item_text.R1: main resolved by git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main at each run (the pre-landing safeguard, F and landing); H on main's first-parent chain; first-parent commits on H..main changing AGENTS.md equal side_change_commits
item_text.R2: AGENTS.md blob at main equals blobs.M
item_text.R3: overlapping occurrence count of D296 old bytes at H is 1, at start_H; sha256(H[start_H:end_H]) = old_sha256
item_text.R4: the same at main: count 1 at start_M; sha256(main[start_M:end_M]) = old_sha256
item_text.R5: common prefix of H and main >= end_H, so translation is identity (else the recorded delta equals the length change before start_H, and no main_changes range meets [start_M,end_M))
item_text.R6: with new and new_sha256 taken from the run's ledger and edit list (bound by R13): Lx = main[:start_M]+new+main[end_M:]; Lx[start_M:start_M+len(new)] = new; sha256(new) = new_sha256; lines 36-39 of Lx equal those of H+D296 (T1')
item_text.R7: git blob id and sha256 of Lx equal expected.L
item_text.R8: git blob id and sha256 of H+D296 equal expected.X and the expected_sha256 of the AGENTS.md entry of the run's ledger (bound by R13)
item_text.R9: '## §A.49' occurs once in main and in Lx, at a >= end_M; Lx[a+delta:b+delta] = main[a:b] with the recorded sha256; and Lx[end_M+delta:] = main[end_M:]
item_text.R10: every files entry of the run's ledger other than AGENTS.md: blob at main equals blob at H, and sha256 equals its base_sha256
item_text.R11: no corpus path changed H..main; every other changed path is covered by a referenced side-change class record (or another reviewed class record, such as the tool's landing paths or the plan amendment's paths)
item_text.R13: ledger binding, checked first: the run's ledger has base = scientific_base, and its AGENTS.md files entry, its AGENTS.md splice list and the run's edit-list records for AGENTS.md have the canonical sha256 values of ledger_binding; otherwise the record does not apply and a superseding record is needed
